name: Rebamipide
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 100 mg three times daily (morning, evening, bedtime)

usual_adult_dose.indication: Gastric mucosal lesions in acute gastritis or acute exacerbation of chronic gastritis

monitoring: Liver tests and blood counts if symptomatic

pk.half_life_eskd: Prolonged after a single dose; no accumulation on dialysis
pk.metabolism: Minimal (8-hydroxy metabolite about 0.03%; CYP3A4 in vitro)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 10% of a dose in urine, mostly unchanged

sources.citation: Nipro Corporation. (2023). Rebamipide tablets 100 mg "NP" [Japanese package insert, 1st edition, revised October 2023]. Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA), Japan.
